records.title: Noetic Topos measures cognition, alignment, or safety
records.claim_text: The formal Noetic Topos construction is an empirically validated measurement of cognition, alignment, or safety.
records.falsifier: The formal source explicitly defers empirical validation; a negative preregistered validation or larger matched-control effect would falsify a future scoped claim.
records.uncertainty: No qualifying empirical estimate is attached to this record.
reviewers: Project Coherence internal mathematical red team
notes: A formal topos-existence theorem cannot license this empirical claim.

records.title: Projector profiles establish latent cognitive capacity
records.claim_text: Learned projector-valued profiles identify CAS/TKS cognitive subspaces and satisfy a capacity bound that predicts held-out model behavior.
records.falsifier: No held-out specificity gain over the mixed-simplex baseline, larger control effects, unstable projectors, or failure to construct the theorem's intertwiner.
records.uncertainty: No qualifying estimate exists; the mathematical capacity transfer has a proof gap.
reviewers: Project Coherence internal mathematical red team
notes: Kernel correctness and empirical representation validity are separate questions.

records.title: CAS-Ohm scores are physical electrical measurements
records.claim_text: CAS-Ohm design scores, behavioral proxies, or model-derived quantities are physical electrical telemetry or validated measurements.
records.falsifier: Absence of an instrumented field, failure of calibration/linearity, or disagreement with known-fault measurements.
records.uncertainty: Current source boundaries classify uninstrumented quantities as design values, proxies, or scores rather than telemetry.
notes: Zero instrumented fields remain calibration exercises and are excluded from Evidence Packets.

records.title: Historical Harness v1.6 establishes current production readiness
records.claim_text: The CAS Harness v1.6 reconciled spec sheet is sufficient current evidence of production readiness or customer efficacy.
records.falsifier: Any current unresolved gate, unavailable provider path, failing acceptance test, stale deployment, or missing claim record defeats the blanket readiness claim.
records.uncertainty: The v1.6 artifact is historical and contains superseded or retracted language; current status must be rechecked.
notes: No research theorem automatically changes the live product-claim record.

records.title: Profile-specific held-out local response
records.claim_text: Within one versioned model, test point, direction, context, and active-region calibration profile, independently measured activation projection varies predictably with randomized steering alpha on held-out prompts.

contexts: Fixed test point and active-region profile

records.falsifier: Failure to predict held-out activation response, nonlinearity outside declared tolerance, larger matched-control effects, profile drift, or cutoff/saturation contamination.
records.uncertainty: No qualifying held-out estimate or Evidence Packet is attached.
notes: This tests a profile-specific response relation, not physical Ohm's law, attention, cognition, or safety.

records.title: Held-out effective-resistance prediction
records.claim_text: An effective-resistance parameter fit on calibration prompts in alpha-per-activation units predicts held-out activation response at fixed independently characterized constraints, and its inverse slope changes as predicted under non-safety constraint manipulation.
records.falsifier: Circular same-sample definition/validation, held-out prediction failure, unchanged inverse slope under a validated constraint manipulation, mixed units, or unstable fit.
records.uncertainty: No qualifying resistance estimate, confidence interval, or replication exists.
notes: ConstraintScore and EffectiveResistance are different types; physical ohms are forbidden aliases.

records.title: Active-region gain composition
records.claim_text: For coordinate-compatible, independently calibrated active-region stages, the measured end-to-end local derivative agrees within preregistered tolerance with the product of local Jacobian/projection gains.
records.falsifier: End-to-end gain differs beyond tolerance, coordinates are incompatible, or any stage leaves the declared active region.
records.uncertainty: Fisher-Rao and local Jacobian gain remain unbridged; no P2 result exists.
notes: Multiplicative beta is capability-gated and never the default arithmetic.

records.title: Parallel-path redundancy response
records.claim_text: In a non-safety circuit with independently calibrated candidate branches, ablating one genuine redundant branch increases the steering alpha required for a fixed held-out effect more than matched random-head ablation.
records.falsifier: No specific alpha increase, larger random-control effect, branch interaction incompatible with the profile, or unsafe intervention requirement.
records.uncertainty: No P3 estimate or validated parallel-equivalence capability exists.
notes: Never weaken a safety direction to validate this hypothesis.

records.title: Blinded residual fault localization
records.claim_text: A calibrated residual diagnostic localizes implanted held-out non-safety faults more accurately than shuffled and matched-control baselines without treating residual sign as proof of a hidden policy or bypass.

scope.population: Synthetic and later preregistered non-safety faults

records.falsifier: Localization does not beat controls, calibration/profile drift explains the residual, or uncertainty includes non-identifying alternatives.
records.uncertainty: Residuals are non-identifying and censored when observed response is zero; no P4 result exists.
notes: Withdraw hidden-cause language if the blinded localization gate fails.

records.title: Complete PCBA/CCDL compiler conformance
records.claim_text: The published PCBA grammar and available implementations completely parse, type-check, simulate, and verify the five reference boards.
records.falsifier: Any published board construct is outside the formal grammar or implementation, any unsupported form is accepted, or no deterministic executable semantics exists.
records.uncertainty: The audit found a direct grammar/board mismatch and only reduced implementation subsets.
notes: The isolated v8 Python object model does not claim complete CCDL parsing.

records.title: CSB safety effectiveness and certification
records.claim_text: The published CSB reference design executes its stated refusal/fuse behavior and establishes safety, certification, regulatory compliance, or clinical suitability.
records.falsifier: The red output cannot reach the fuse threshold, beta is non-finite, latch/fuse behavior is undefined, a fault suppresses refusal, or independent validation fails.
records.uncertainty: The published `sat=0.1` / `threshold=0.9` values are a direct counterexample to the stated fuse crossing; no safety evidence is attached.
notes: The unmodified CSB is retained as a known-fault fixture; legal and regulatory conclusions require qualified human review.
